description: Hand a claimed assignment back to the queue without a result, so another executor or the Syncflow cloud can take it. Use this when the brief is unclear or out of scope, when the work needs access this machine does not have, or when you cannot finish before the claim expires. Releasing is better than going silent: a silent claim blocks the work until it expires. Give a short reason; the task owner sees it.

assignmentId.description: The assignment id this machine claimed.

reason.description: Why it is being handed back. One sentence is enough.

name: release_assignment
